Citing an edition

For an individual work, cite Henry Shin, the work’s title, Tensorgami archival edition 2026-10-20.1, and the archived file linked below. Add a section or page number when referring to a particular argument. The current reading editions remain available through Expositions and Essays.

For the whole collection: Henry Shin, Tensorgami: complete public corpus snapshot, archival edition 2026-10-20.1, GitHub release.

Research papers retain their original authorship, publication status, and arXiv or journal citations. The existing reuse terms apply to the archived material.
